quests.title: Evermotion Mechanical Painting: Invoker

dialogue.t: What a surprise. To think that my invention could be used in this fashion...
Ah, Traveler! It seems we meet again... *cough*

dialogue.sit: Did something go wrong with your invention again?

dialogue.t: That was the plan, yes, but... Things do change, you know...
*cough* But let's get back on topic.
This time, I've been invited by the Mondstadt Adventurers' Guild to create several Mechanical Paintings based on certain card faces that can be disassembled and reassembled.
As for the card game, what was it again... Ah, right, it's called Genius Invokation TCG.
According to them, these paintings will be brought to be used in the King of Invokations Grand Prix as a sort of minigame to liven things up just a bit.
*sigh* These things are too complicated for me. I should just concentrate on my inventions.
Ah, yes, Mondstadt's mechanical paintings are with me, so if you want to play around with them, feel free.

quests.description: Félix Yogue seems to be busy with something in Mondstadt…
